Read the accounts of the people of each server

report_server_reads.Rd

Asks every server in asks for the names it was given and says, for each, whether it was read. A server that was not read is not an error: the report goes on and the pairs of that server fall back on what the directory says. The reason is a code, one of TRASPORTO_ISTANZA_SENZA_MODULO (the server has no host), TRASPORTO_SEGRETO_NON_LEGGIBILE (no secret, or an NA), the first code of the failed module_accounts(), or INTERNO when the answer is not a reading (see report_accounts_frame()).

Usage

report_server_reads(asks, hosts, secrets)

Arguments

asks

Named list: server name to the user names to ask it.

hosts

Named character vector: server name to host.

secrets

Named character vector: server name to secret.

Value

A named list with one element per server of asks: list(letto = TRUE, conti = <frame>) or list(letto = FALSE, motivo = <code>).

Details

Blank and missing names are not asked: module_accounts() lets them pass. A call that raises an error is a server not read, with reason INTERNO.
